title: The Rise of Foundation Models: From GPT to Multimodal AI
abstract: This keynote explores the rapid evolution of foundation models, from early transformer architectures to today's multimodal systems. We'll discuss how these models are reshaping industries, the technical challenges of scaling, and what the next generation of AI systems might look like.
keywords: foundation models, transformers, multimodal AI, large language models, GPT

title: Optimizing Inference for Large Language Models
abstract: As LLMs grow larger, efficient inference becomes critical. This talk presents novel techniques for optimizing LLM inference, including quantization strategies, speculative decoding, and KV-cache optimization. We demonstrate 3x throughput improvements while maintaining model quality.
keywords: LLM optimization, inference, quantization, speculative decoding, performance

title: Building Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems at Scale
abstract: RAG systems are essential for grounding LLMs in factual knowledge. This presentation covers the architecture of production RAG systems, including vector database selection, chunking strategies, reranking approaches, and hybrid search techniques.
keywords: RAG, retrieval augmented generation, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search

title: Fine-tuning Strategies for Domain-Specific Applications
abstract: Generic LLMs often underperform on specialized tasks. We present a comprehensive study of fine-tuning approaches including LoRA, QLoRA, and full fine-tuning across legal, medical, and financial domains.
keywords: fine-tuning, LoRA, domain adaptation, transfer learning, specialized LLMs

title: Real-Time Object Detection: Beyond YOLO
abstract: While YOLO revolutionized real-time detection, new architectures are pushing boundaries further. We present RT-DETR variants and transformer-based detectors achieving state-of-the-art results at 100+ FPS.
keywords: object detection, YOLO, RT-DETR, real-time AI, edge deployment

title: Vision-Language Models: Bridging Visual and Textual Understanding
abstract: Vision-language models like CLIP, BLIP-2, and LLaVA are enabling new applications from visual QA to content generation. This talk explores their architectures, training methodologies, and practical applications.
keywords: vision-language models, CLIP, BLIP, visual understanding, multimodal

title: Video Understanding with Temporal Transformers
abstract: Understanding video requires modeling temporal relationships across frames. We present advances in video transformers, from ViViT to VideoMAE, with applications in action recognition and video captioning.
keywords: video understanding, temporal transformers, action recognition, video AI

title: AI in Drug Discovery: From Target Identification to Lead Optimization
abstract: AI is transforming pharmaceutical research. This workshop covers ML applications across the drug discovery pipeline, from protein structure prediction to ADMET property prediction and de novo molecule generation.
keywords: drug discovery, AI pharma, molecular ML, protein folding, drug design

title: Responsible AI: Building Ethical and Fair ML Systems
abstract: This panel brings together experts to discuss practical approaches to responsible AI development. Topics include bias detection, fairness metrics, transparency requirements, and regulatory compliance across industries.
keywords: responsible AI, ethics, fairness, bias, AI governance

title: The Future of AI: 2025 and Beyond
abstract: What breakthroughs can we expect in the next decade? This keynote examines emerging research directions, from neuromorphic computing to artificial general intelligence, and discusses the technical and societal challenges ahead.
keywords: future AI, AGI, neuromorphic computing, AI trends, emerging technology

title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: Theory and Practice
abstract: RLHF has become essential for aligning language models with human preferences. This presentation covers reward modeling, PPO training, and constitutional AI approaches with hands-on implementation guidance.
keywords: RLHF, human feedback, alignment, reward modeling, PPO

title: Constitutional AI and Self-Supervision for Safer Models
abstract: Beyond RLHF, constitutional AI offers scalable approaches to model alignment. We discuss the theory behind CAI, implementation strategies, and empirical results on reducing harmful outputs.
keywords: constitutional AI, safety, alignment, self-supervision, AI safety

title: Multi-Agent Systems: Collaborative AI Architectures
abstract: Single agents have limitations. This talk explores multi-agent systems where specialized AI agents collaborate on complex tasks, from code generation to research synthesis.
keywords: multi-agent, collaborative AI, agent systems, orchestration, emergent behavior

title: Neural Architecture Search: Automating Model Design
abstract: NAS automates the tedious process of architecture design. We cover efficient NAS methods including weight sharing, differentiable search, and hardware-aware optimization for resource-constrained environments.
keywords: NAS, neural architecture search, AutoML, model optimization, efficiency

title: Knowledge Distillation: Efficient Model Compression
abstract: Large models are expensive to deploy. Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities to smaller models efficiently. We present state-of-the-art techniques achieving 10x compression with minimal performance loss.
keywords: knowledge distillation, model compression, efficiency, deployment, edge AI

title: ML Model Monitoring: Detecting Drift and Maintaining Quality
abstract: Models degrade in production. This talk covers monitoring strategies for data drift, concept drift, and model performance degradation with automated retraining pipelines.
keywords: model monitoring, ML drift, production ML, model quality, MLOps

title: Prompt Engineering Workshop: Advanced Techniques
abstract: Master the art of prompt engineering. This hands-on workshop covers chain-of-thought, few-shot learning, tree-of-thought, and structured output techniques for maximum LLM performance.
keywords: prompt engineering, LLM, chain-of-thought, few-shot, structured outputs

title: GitOps and Infrastructure as Code: Modern Deployment Patterns
abstract: This keynote explores the evolution of deployment practices from traditional ops to GitOps. We'll cover ArgoCD, Flux, and Terraform patterns that enable reliable, auditable infrastructure management.
keywords: GitOps, IaC, Terraform, ArgoCD, infrastructure automation

title: Kubernetes Operators: Automating Complex Deployments
abstract: Kubernetes operators extend cluster capabilities for managing complex stateful applications. Learn to build custom operators using Kubebuilder and Operator SDK with production-ready patterns.
keywords: Kubernetes, operators, automation, Kubebuilder, stateful applications

title: Service Mesh Deep Dive: Istio vs Linkerd
abstract: Service meshes provide observability, security, and traffic management. This comparative analysis helps you choose between Istio and Linkerd based on your requirements and constraints.
keywords: service mesh, Istio, Linkerd, microservices, observability

title: Container Security: From Build to Runtime
abstract: Container security requires attention at every stage. We cover image scanning, runtime protection, secrets management, and compliance automation for enterprise Kubernetes environments.
keywords: container security, Kubernetes security, image scanning, runtime protection

title: Observability at Scale: Building Effective Monitoring Systems
abstract: Observability is more than monitoring. This talk covers building comprehensive observability systems with metrics, logs, and traces that enable rapid incident response and proactive optimization.
keywords: observability, monitoring, metrics, tracing, incident response

title: Chaos Engineering: Building Resilient Systems
abstract: Chaos engineering proactively identifies weaknesses before they cause outages. Learn to implement chaos experiments safely with tools like Chaos Monkey, Litmus, and Gremlin.
keywords: chaos engineering, resilience, reliability, Chaos Monkey, failure injection

title: Platform Engineering: Building Internal Developer Platforms
abstract: Platform engineering abstracts infrastructure complexity. We discuss designing IDPs with Backstage, Crossplane, and custom tooling that accelerate development while maintaining governance.
keywords: platform engineering, IDP, Backstage, developer experience, golden paths

title: CI/CD Workshop: From Zero to Production in 3 Hours
abstract: Build a complete CI/CD pipeline from scratch. This hands-on workshop covers GitHub Actions, testing strategies, deployment automation, and rollback mechanisms for production systems.
keywords: CI/CD, GitHub Actions, automation, testing, deployment

title: The Future of Healthcare: AI-Powered Diagnostics
abstract: AI is revolutionizing medical diagnostics. This keynote examines breakthroughs in medical imaging analysis, early disease detection, and personalized treatment recommendations powered by machine learning.
keywords: healthcare AI, medical diagnostics, medical imaging, precision medicine

title: Electronic Health Records: Interoperability Challenges
abstract: EHR interoperability remains a critical challenge. This talk explores FHIR standards, API design patterns, and practical solutions for enabling seamless health data exchange.
keywords: EHR, interoperability, FHIR, health data, healthcare IT

title: Telemedicine Platforms: Architecture and Security
abstract: Building telemedicine platforms requires balancing user experience with strict security requirements. We share architectural patterns for scalable, HIPAA-compliant video consultation systems.
keywords: telemedicine, healthcare security, HIPAA, video platforms, remote care

title: Wearable Health Tech: From Data Collection to Insights
abstract: Wearables generate continuous health data streams. This presentation covers processing pipelines, real-time analysis, and clinical integration for actionable health insights.
keywords: wearables, health monitoring, real-time analysis, health data, IoT

title: ML in Radiology: Detecting Cancer Earlier
abstract: Machine learning is achieving radiologist-level performance in cancer detection. We present our research on mammography and CT scan analysis with clinical validation results.
keywords: radiology AI, cancer detection, medical imaging, deep learning, diagnostics

title: Natural Language Processing for Clinical Documentation
abstract: Clinical notes contain rich information locked in unstructured text. This talk covers NLP techniques for extracting diagnoses, medications, and clinical insights from doctor notes.
keywords: clinical NLP, medical text mining, healthcare AI, documentation, extraction

title: Drug Interaction Prediction Using Graph Neural Networks
abstract: Predicting drug interactions prevents adverse events. We present a graph neural network approach that models molecular interactions and achieves state-of-the-art prediction accuracy.
keywords: drug interactions, GNN, pharmacology, molecular ML, patient safety

title: Healthcare Data Privacy Workshop
abstract: Navigate the complex landscape of healthcare data privacy. This workshop covers HIPAA compliance, GDPR requirements, data anonymization techniques, and privacy-preserving analytics.
keywords: healthcare privacy, HIPAA, GDPR, data protection, anonymization

title: React Server Components: A New Paradigm
abstract: Server Components change how we think about React applications. This talk explores the architecture, performance benefits, and migration strategies for existing applications.
keywords: React, Server Components, Next.js, performance, web development

title: Building Type-Safe Full-Stack Applications
abstract: End-to-end type safety eliminates runtime errors. Learn how tRPC, Prisma, and TypeScript combine to create bulletproof applications with minimal boilerplate.
keywords: TypeScript, tRPC, Prisma, type safety, full-stack

title: Modern CSS: Container Queries and Beyond
abstract: CSS has evolved dramatically. This presentation covers container queries, cascade layers, :has() selector, and other modern features transforming how we style web applications.
keywords: CSS, container queries, modern CSS, styling, web design

title: Edge Computing: Running Code Closer to Users
abstract: Edge functions enable near-instant response times globally. We compare Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, and Deno Deploy with real-world performance benchmarks.
keywords: edge computing, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, performance, CDN

title: API Design Patterns: REST, GraphQL, and gRPC
abstract: Choosing the right API paradigm impacts your entire architecture. This comparative analysis helps you select and implement the optimal approach for your use case.
keywords: API design, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, architecture

title: Web Performance Optimization: Core Web Vitals Mastery
abstract: Core Web Vitals directly impact SEO and user experience. Learn advanced techniques for optimizing LCP, FID, and CLS with real examples from high-traffic sites.
keywords: web performance, Core Web Vitals, optimization, LCP, FID, CLS

title: Next.js 15 Workshop: Full-Stack React Development
abstract: Build a complete application with Next.js 15. This workshop covers App Router, Server Actions, data fetching patterns, and deployment strategies.
keywords: Next.js, React, full-stack, Server Actions, web development

title: Zero Trust Architecture: Beyond the Perimeter
abstract: This keynote examines the shift from perimeter-based security to zero trust. We cover implementation strategies, identity-centric security, and lessons from enterprise deployments.
keywords: zero trust, security architecture, identity, enterprise security

title: Threat Modeling for Modern Applications
abstract: Threat modeling identifies vulnerabilities before attackers do. Learn practical methodologies including STRIDE, DREAD, and attack trees with hands-on exercises.
keywords: threat modeling, security, STRIDE, vulnerabilities, risk assessment

title: Secure Code Review: Finding Vulnerabilities at Scale
abstract: Code review is your first defense against vulnerabilities. This talk covers automated SAST tools, manual review techniques, and integrating security into pull request workflows.
keywords: code review, SAST, security testing, vulnerabilities, secure development

title: Supply Chain Security: Protecting Dependencies
abstract: Supply chain attacks are increasing. Learn to secure your dependency management with SBOM generation, vulnerability scanning, and policy enforcement.
keywords: supply chain security, SBOM, dependencies, vulnerability management

title: Incident Response: From Detection to Recovery
abstract: When breaches occur, response time matters. This presentation covers building incident response playbooks, communication protocols, and post-incident analysis.
keywords: incident response, security operations, breach detection, recovery, SOC

title: Red Team Operations: Thinking Like an Attacker
abstract: Red teams simulate real attackers to find weaknesses. Learn penetration testing methodologies, common attack vectors, and how to communicate findings effectively.
keywords: red team, penetration testing, offensive security, attack simulation

title: Cloud Security Posture Management
abstract: Cloud misconfigurations cause most breaches. We cover CSPM tools, automated compliance checking, and remediation strategies for AWS, Azure, and GCP.
keywords: CSPM, cloud security, compliance, AWS security, Azure security

title: Modern Data Stack: From Ingestion to Insights
abstract: This keynote surveys the modern data stack landscape. We examine how tools like Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, and Looker combine to enable data-driven organizations.
keywords: modern data stack, data engineering, analytics, data platform

title: Real-Time Data Pipelines with Apache Kafka
abstract: Kafka enables real-time data processing at scale. Learn to design event-driven architectures, optimize throughput, and ensure exactly-once semantics.
keywords: Kafka, streaming, real-time data, event-driven, data pipelines

title: Apache Spark Optimization Techniques
abstract: Spark performance depends on understanding its internals. This talk covers partitioning strategies, caching, broadcast joins, and debugging slow queries.
keywords: Apache Spark, optimization, big data, performance, distributed computing

title: dbt Best Practices: Scalable Analytics Engineering
abstract: dbt has transformed analytics engineering. Learn project structure, testing strategies, documentation practices, and performance optimization for enterprise deployments.
keywords: dbt, analytics engineering, data transformation, SQL, data modeling

title: Data Quality: Ensuring Trust in Your Data
abstract: Bad data leads to bad decisions. This presentation covers data quality dimensions, testing frameworks, monitoring strategies, and organizational processes for data trust.
keywords: data quality, data testing, data validation, data trust, governance

title: Data Lakehouse Architecture with Delta Lake
abstract: Delta Lake brings reliability to data lakes. Learn ACID transactions, time travel, schema evolution, and performance optimization for analytics workloads.
keywords: Delta Lake, data lakehouse, ACID, data lake, analytics

title: Feature Stores: Bridging Data Engineering and ML
abstract: Feature stores enable ML teams to share and reuse features. We compare Feast, Tecton, and Databricks Feature Store with implementation guidance.
keywords: feature stores, MLOps, feature engineering, Feast, ML platforms

title: Data Pipeline Workshop: Building End-to-End Flows
abstract: Build production data pipelines from scratch. This workshop covers Airflow orchestration, data validation, error handling, and monitoring best practices.
keywords: data pipelines, Airflow, orchestration, data engineering, ETL

title: Cross-Platform Development: One Codebase, Every Platform
abstract: This keynote examines the state of cross-platform development. We compare React Native, Flutter, and Kotlin Multiplatform with honest assessments of trade-offs.
keywords: cross-platform, React Native, Flutter, mobile development

title: SwiftUI Advanced Patterns
abstract: SwiftUI enables declarative iOS development. This talk covers advanced patterns including custom view modifiers, environment values, and animation composition.
keywords: SwiftUI, iOS, Swift, mobile development, declarative UI

title: Jetpack Compose: Modern Android UI
abstract: Jetpack Compose is Android's declarative UI toolkit. Learn composition patterns, state management, and performance optimization for production applications.
keywords: Jetpack Compose, Android, Kotlin, UI development, declarative

title: Mobile App Architecture: Clean Code for Mobile
abstract: Well-architected apps are maintainable and testable. We explore MVVM, MVI, and Clean Architecture patterns with practical examples in Swift and Kotlin.
keywords: mobile architecture, MVVM, Clean Architecture, iOS, Android

title: Mobile Performance: Achieving 60fps
abstract: Users expect smooth experiences. This presentation covers profiling tools, optimization techniques, and common performance pitfalls in iOS and Android development.
keywords: mobile performance, optimization, profiling, iOS, Android

title: Offline-First Mobile Applications
abstract: Great mobile apps work without connectivity. Learn offline-first architectures, local storage strategies, and synchronization patterns for reliable apps.
keywords: offline-first, mobile apps, synchronization, local storage, reliability

title: Mobile Security Best Practices
abstract: Mobile apps face unique security challenges. This talk covers secure storage, certificate pinning, code obfuscation, and compliance requirements.
keywords: mobile security, app security, secure storage, certificate pinning

title: Flutter Workshop: Building Beautiful Apps
abstract: Build a complete Flutter application from scratch. This workshop covers widget composition, state management with Riverpod, and platform-specific customization.
keywords: Flutter, Dart, mobile development, cross-platform, Riverpod

title: Large Language Models: Theory and Applications
abstract: This keynote provides a deep dive into LLM fundamentals. We cover transformer architectures, training objectives, emergent capabilities, and frontier research directions.
keywords: LLM, transformers, deep learning, AI research, language models

title: Sparse Attention Mechanisms
abstract: Standard attention scales quadratically. We present sparse attention variants achieving linear complexity while maintaining model quality on long sequences.
keywords: sparse attention, efficient transformers, long context, attention mechanisms

title: Mixture of Experts: Scaling Beyond Dense Models
abstract: MoE architectures enable efficient scaling to trillion parameters. This talk covers routing mechanisms, load balancing, and training stability techniques.
keywords: mixture of experts, model scaling, efficient AI, routing, MoE

title: Multimodal Learning: Unifying Vision and Language
abstract: Multimodal models process multiple data types jointly. We review architectures from CLIP to GPT-4V, discussing fusion strategies and emergent capabilities.
keywords: multimodal AI, vision-language, CLIP, GPT-4V, cross-modal

title: Cloud-Native Architecture: Principles and Patterns
abstract: This keynote establishes the foundations of cloud-native design. We cover the twelve-factor app, microservices patterns, and infrastructure as code principles.
keywords: cloud-native, architecture, microservices, twelve-factor, patterns

title: Multi-Cloud Strategies: Avoiding Lock-In
abstract: Multi-cloud provides flexibility but adds complexity. Learn abstraction strategies, cost optimization techniques, and when multi-cloud makes sense.
keywords: multi-cloud, cloud architecture, abstraction, cost optimization

title: Serverless at Scale: Patterns and Pitfalls
abstract: Serverless simplifies operations but introduces new challenges. This talk covers cold starts, state management, testing strategies, and cost optimization.
keywords: serverless, AWS Lambda, cloud functions, FaaS, scaling

title: Database Selection for Cloud Applications
abstract: Choosing the right database impacts everything. We compare managed databases across AWS, Azure, and GCP with decision frameworks for common use cases.
keywords: cloud databases, managed databases, database selection, AWS, Azure, GCP

title: FinOps: Managing Cloud Costs Effectively
abstract: Cloud costs spiral without governance. This presentation covers FinOps principles, cost allocation strategies, and tools for visibility and optimization.
keywords: FinOps, cloud costs, cost optimization, cloud governance, budgeting

title: Event-Driven Architecture with Cloud Services
abstract: Event-driven designs enable loosely coupled, scalable systems. Learn to implement with AWS EventBridge, Azure Event Grid, and GCP Pub/Sub.
keywords: event-driven, architecture, EventBridge, messaging, cloud events

title: Disaster Recovery in the Cloud
abstract: DR planning ensures business continuity. This talk covers RPO/RTO planning, backup strategies, failover automation, and testing DR procedures.
keywords: disaster recovery, business continuity, backup, failover, cloud DR

title: Kubernetes on Cloud Workshop
abstract: Deploy production Kubernetes on major cloud platforms. This workshop covers EKS, AKS, and GKE setup, networking, storage, and operational best practices.
keywords: Kubernetes, EKS, AKS, GKE, cloud Kubernetes, container orchestration
